ns2:course.label: Component Design
ns2:course.description: Design of basic engineering components: structural members, machine parts, and connections. Principles applied include: material failure (yield, fracture, fatigue); buckling and other instabilities; design reliability; analytical simulation. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: SE 311 and SE 320.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: SE 311 and SE 320.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Engineering. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is an approved Design Elective in the SE Undergraduate curriculum.
